in_marathi.name: Harishchand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Hari's Moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harishchand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harishchand is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Hari and Chand. Hari is an epithet of Vishnu, meaning 'God'. Chand means 'moon'. Thus, Harishchand can be translated as 'God Hari's Moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered to be a symbol of peace, tranquility, and calmness. The name Harishchand is believed to bestow upon the bearer these qualities and more.
